primaryAnalysis.rule: Only journal-verified, counted submissions from sessions whose experimental validity allows primary analysis enter the primary verified metrics. Everything else is preserved and reported here, never pooled into primary figures (D91).

columns.note: Abstentions are their own column: they are neither predictions nor errors and enter no accuracy figure. Submitter-authored and externally translated representations are reported separately and never pooled.

buildReferences.note: build conditions are written in discovery build ids; held-out situations are aligned to them through eval/ (D88). An unresolved id names no discovery build and can never apply.

outcomeChecks.note: descriptive, conditional on recorded checks: checks within one situation and situations within one match are correlated

situations.unit: situations with at least one recorded check, all matching
situations.note: descriptive, conditional on recorded checks: turns of one match are not independent replicates

fullyEvaluated.unit: situations with every check recorded, none contradicting

partiallyEvaluated.note: situations where some checks have no recorded outcome or an unknown input: not counted as verified successes

units.unit: cases and matches with at least one recorded check, none contradicting
units.note: descriptive, conditional on recorded checks: one scripted case or one match counts once, but units are not independent replicates (matches of one seed are paired; cases of one script form a family)

fullyEvaluated.unit: units with every check recorded, none contradicting

partiallyEvaluated.note: units where some checks have no recorded outcome or an unknown input: not counted as verified successes

replication.basis: matches grouped by seed (eval/ matchSeeds); cases grouped by script
replication.note: Independent replication is at most the number of groups, not the number of units. Wilson intervals above are descriptive summaries of these observations; they are not confidence statements about the rule, and with few groups they overstate precision.

caveat: Discovery fit and held-out predictive accuracy are different measures. Held-out accuracy is over the representation as structured (fidelity declared by its author, not checked); it says nothing about situations not evaluated and does not identify a unique rule. No composite score is formed.
